verdict.rationale: ClickUp's homepage directly claims 'Build your own agent' alongside its Super Agent and prebuilt Codegen and Triage agents, so it is a first-party capability for this story. The evidence is only marketing headlines, with nothing on how users configure an agent's instructions, tools, triggers or permissions. The MCP server is not credited here because it lets external agents connect to ClickUp rather than letting users build agents inside it. Missing for 10: documentation of the agent builder and its configuration options (instructions, knowledge sources, tools/actions, triggers), detail on model selection per agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration that users can build working custom agents.
